name: Node.js
author: JustArtiom@users.noreply.github.com
description: Runs a Node.js app or script from uploaded files or a Git repository. Dependencies are installed with npm, pnpm or Yarn when the server starts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

log() {
    printf '[System] %s\n' "$1"
}

git_with_credentials() {
    local -a options=(-c safe.directory=/mnt/server)

    if [[ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        options+=(
            -c credential.helper=
            -c 'credential.helper=!f() { echo "username=${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}"; echo "password=${GIT_TOKEN}"; }; f'
        )
    fi

    git "${options[@]}" "$@"
}

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    log 'No Git repository set. Upload your files, or set a Git repository and reinstall.'
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
    log "Updating the existing checkout of ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if ! git_with_credentials pull --ff-only; then
        log 'Could not update the checkout, keeping the existing files.'
    fi
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "$(ls -A)" ]]; then
    log 'The server already has files but no Git checkout, so nothing was cloned. Delete the files and reinstall to clone the repository.'
    exit 0
fi

clone_args=(clone --depth 1)
if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then
    clone_args+=(--branch "$BRANCH")
fi

log "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if ! git_with_credentials "${clone_args[@]}" "$GIT_ADDRESS" .; then
    log 'Cloning failed. Check the repository address, the branch and the access token.'
    exit 1
fi

log 'Repository cloned. Dependencies are installed when the server starts.'

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS address of a Git repository to clone on install, for example https://github.com/you/your-bot. Leave empty to upload files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Leave empty for the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Username for a private repository. Leave empty for public repositories.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: Personal access token for a private repository. It is passed to Git when needed and never saved in the repository's files.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Pull the latest commit from the Git repository every time the server starts.

variables.name: Install dependencies
variables.description: Install the dependencies from package.json when the server starts. Skipped when nothing changed since the last install; delete node_modules to force a clean install.

variables.name: Package manager
variables.description: Package manager for installing dependencies. Auto uses the packageManager field in package.json (any pnpm or Yarn version), then the lockfile, then npm.

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: File to start with Node.js, for example index.js or src/bot.ts. Leave empty to use the start script from package.json, then its main file, then index.js.

variables.name: Node.js arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments for Node.js, for example --max-old-space-size=256.

variables.name: Start command
variables.description: Custom command to run instead of the main file, for example npm run build && npm start. Leave empty to start the main file.
